title: Towel Bar 18-Inch Wall-Mounted Powder Coated Pipe | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Clear counter space and keep towels drying neatly with this wall-mounted towel bar. This bath towel bar (also called a towel rack or towel holder) brings an industrial pipe-fitting look that blends with both modern and traditional bathroom decor.

Highlights:
- Organize daily bath linens with a wall mount / wall-mounted / wall-hanging towel bar design
- Create a coordinated look with the Pipeline towel bars collection for transitional bathroom hardware
- Keep the finish looking clean with a highly durable powder coat on the pipe
- Rely on corrosion-free and rust-free performance for versatile bath accessories
- Match installation details with color-coordinating screws and included mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: towel bar / towel rack / towel holder
- Collection: Pipeline
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 5 x 5 in.
- Shipping weight: 2.2 lbs
- Finish: powder coated
- Mounting: wall-mounted; color coordinated mounting hardware included
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
